properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EKITIIBWA kyo kinene,
Omununuzi waffe;
Emimwa gy'abantu bonna
Giyimba-ettendo lyo!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Erinnya lya Yesu ddungi
Limalawo-okutya;
Lituleetera-obulamu
N'emirembe mu nda.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Amaanyi g'ekibi gonna
Yesu yagamenya;
Ffe abaali abasibe
Twafuuka ba ddembe!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Buli akkiriza Yesu
Alirokolebwa;
N'abo abaafiira mu ye
Kaakano balamu!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Muwulire mmwe-abanaku
Nammwe bakasiru,
Bwe munaasembera gy'ali
Munaawonyezebwa!

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Mukama waffe-ow'ekisa
Tukwegayirira,
Otuyigirize fenna
Okukusuutanga.
